slogan: Focu: the way to digest information in the agentic age.
name: People I Follow
description: The people the owner demonstrably follows, on their own sites and channels: Simon Willison's blog, Grant Sanderson's 3Blue1Brown, Dwarkesh Patel's interviews, Lex Fridman's podcast, 北美王路飞's market courses and 硅谷101's deep interviews. Six verified sources — two blogs and four YouTube channels; the YouTube sources also prove the pack system carries youtube-type sources end to end.
rationale: People I Follow is the recommended starter because it is people, not platforms: six verified sources the curator demonstrably follows, on their own sites and channels. It is a recommendation only when the user asked their agent to choose; it is never installed silently.
swap: Preview the replacement first: .venv/bin/focu pack preview <replacement pack_file> --config sources.yaml
Remove the default: .venv/bin/focu pack uninstall followed-people --config sources.yaml
Install the replacement with its own install_command from marketplace/catalog.json.
Exactly one starter pack at a time; installing a pack enables nothing else.
